dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: There are so many enemies here! If all of them were written into a youkai story, it'd be dark long before you finished just reading the names out!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: But fear not! The Invincible Yoimiya is here to save you from the clutches of the evil youkai!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: ...Haha, okay, that was a little embarrassing... But I sounded pretty cool, right?
